latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Maker Intro Free — create free branded intro videos from your logo and tagline.

- Instantly turn logo images and tagline text into 1080p branded intro clips for YouTube or social media.
- Fast and simple: just upload your media and describe the intro; receive an MP4 download in under a minute.
- No editing timeline or export settings required; everything handled automatically in the cloud.
- Includes free credits for new users and a seamless connection process (no account required).
- Supports video, image, and audio uploads in common formats, with step-by-step status feedback during processing.
